title: ClawBio pipeline.yaml (v1)
description: Shape of a ClawBio 2.0 skill's pipeline.yaml. This schema covers the structural contract; cross-step semantics (unknown prereqs, forward refs, unresolved {var} placeholders, requires-emit gating) are enforced by the clawbio-flow CLI loader at `clawbio-flow start` time and cannot be expressed in JSON Schema.

version.description: Schema version. Only 1 is accepted today.

inputs.description: Inputs the user or agent supplies at `clawbio-flow start`.

steps.description: Ordered DAG of pipeline steps. Must be non-empty.

required.description: If true, `clawbio-flow start` fails when missing.

summary.description: One-line description shown by `clawbio-flow next` and `clawbio-flow status`.

command_template.description: Shell snippet with {var} placeholders. Resolved at `clawbio-flow open` time from {out}, {skill_dir}, declared inputs, and emits from prior steps. Forbidden: conditionals, loops, templating beyond {var}.

requires_inputs.description: Inputs that must be present at run start.

prereqs.description: Step IDs that must be `done` before this step is unblocked. Must reference earlier steps only.

requires.description: Emit-key gates. Each key must be in some prior step's `emits`. Value is a stub today (use 'present').

emits.description: Output keys this step produces. Matches `clawbio-flow done --output`.

optional.description: If true, this step may be skipped via `clawbio-flow skip <id> --reason ...` instead of executed. Default false — every existing pipeline.yaml keeps validating clean.
